providers.title: Providers and Models
providers.description: Added providers with their endpoints, authentication, headers and enabled models; keys are kept in the local credential store, not here

streamFirstEventTimeoutSeconds.title: First event timeout (seconds)
streamFirstEventTimeoutSeconds.description: Treats a request as stuck when nothing arrives for this long; 0 means no timeout. Raise it for local models that process long contexts slowly

streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.title: Stream idle timeout (seconds)
streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: Treats a reply as stuck when nothing new arrives for this long; 0 means no timeout

catalogAutoUpdate.title: Update model lists automatically
catalogAutoUpdate.description: Once a day, fetches each provider's model list and OMP's online model catalog (catalog.stencil.so) in the background; also fetches right after you add a provider or set its key; when off, lists are fetched only when you choose Refresh

compaction.title: Auto-compaction trigger
compaction.description: Compact automatically when the context reaches this size: keep a reserve, a percent of the window, or a fixed token count. Each model can override it.

providers.title: Providers and Models
providers.description: Add providers, set keys, manage and check models

readOnly: The model service is not running; you can only view for now.

empty.title: No providers yet
empty.description: Add a provider and its key so the writing assistant can call models. For a relay or a local Ollama, LM Studio or vLLM, choose “OpenAI compatible” under Custom.

remove.label: Delete: {{name}}
remove.title: Delete provider “{{name}}”?
remove.roles: Roles using these models become unbound: {{roles}}. Features using them will report an error pointing to “Model Roles” until rebound.
remove.models_one: Its model is removed from the list and its key is deleted from the credential store.
remove.models_other: Its {{count}} models are removed from the list and its key is deleted from the credential store.

key.label: API key
key.hint: Kept in the local credential store, not in the settings file, and never shown again. Write env:NAME to read it from a startup environment variable.
key.empty: Paste an API key, or write env:NAME
key.stored: Set · type a new key to replace it
key.keyless: Leave empty if no key is needed
key.envFound: Read from the startup environment variable {{name}} (found).
key.envMissing: The environment variable {{name}} is not set: set it and restart the app.

url.label: Base URL
url.overridden: Changed to another address; the template address is {{url}}. Model capabilities and prices still come from the template catalog.
url.invalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://

auth.label: Authentication
auth.hint: Which header carries the key. By default it follows the API format: Authorization: Bearer for OpenAI-style APIs, x-api-key for Anthropic

headers.label: Headers
headers.hint: Sent with every request; a model can add or override headers of the same name in its edit dialog

protocol.note: After you change the API format or the address, requests are sent with the generic protocol, without this provider's special handling.

detect.needsKey: Enter an API key to detect
detect.title: Protocol detection results
detect.running: Trying four protocols, one request each…
detect.model: Tried with model {{model}}, one request per protocol.
detect.needModel: This provider has no model to detect with. Enter a model ID and detect again.

codes.endpoint-mismatch: Address doesn't match this protocol's path
codes.unknown-model: Can't build a request for this model ID
codes.no-address: The template has no address for this protocol
codes.proxy-unsupported: Proxy not supported (SOCKS or an automatic configuration script)
codes.proxy-unreadable: Couldn't read the system proxy settings

headers.name: Name
headers.credentialLike: Looks like a credential: write env:NAME so the value stays out of the settings file
headers.nameInvalid: Names may only use letters, digits and -_.!#$%&'*+^`|~

models.title: Models
models.empty: No models yet. Once a key is set, the provider's model list is fetched; you can also add one by hand.
models.checkTip: Check: send a very short request
models.incompleteTip: Fill in the context window to enable it
models.missing: No longer offered by the provider
models.unsupported: Not usable as a chat model
models.confirmDisable: After disabling, these roles cannot use it: {{roles}}.

follow.label: Add new models from the provider automatically
follow.hint: Models newly added to the provider's list (or the built-in catalog when there is no list) show up on their own; turn this off to keep the list as it is.

source.failedKept: Fetch failed: {{reason}}; using the list from {{time}}
source.changed: The address, protocol or credentials changed; refresh to update
source.catalog: Using the built-in model catalog; no list from the provider yet
source.none: No model list from the provider yet

reasons.not-found: this provider has no model list endpoint
reasons.bad-response: the provider did not return a complete model list
reasons.storage: the list could not be saved
reasons.proxy: the proxy setting is not usable, so nothing was sent

confirmCheckAll.title: Check {{count}} models from {{provider}}?
confirmCheckAll.description: Each model sends one real request to the provider and is billed at the provider's price. {{concurrency}} run at a time, and you can cancel at any time.

kinds.network: Could not reach the provider, or the request was interrupted.
kinds.auth: Authentication failed: the provider rejected the key. Check it, or use a key that can access this model.
kinds.context_overflow: The request exceeded the context window.
kinds.local: A local problem: the configuration is incomplete or unusable.

check.unknown: Result unknown: the check was cancelled and the request may have been sent

proxy.proxy-unsupported: The proxy is SOCKS or an automatic configuration script, which isn't supported, so nothing was sent. Use the HTTP port of the proxy software.
proxy.proxy-invalid: The proxy address isn't valid, so nothing was sent. Fix it under Network or in this provider's Advanced settings.
proxy.proxy-unreadable: Couldn't read the system proxy settings, so nothing was sent.

edit.title: Edit model: {{name}}
edit.name: Display name
edit.priceHint: USD per million tokens; empty means unknown, 0 means free
edit.compactHint: Compact when the context reaches the trigger. Keep a reserve: the trigger is the window minus the larger of 15% of it and 16,384; a window size given here is used instead of the model's.
edit.headersHint: Overrides the provider's header of the same name
edit.catalogFixed: From the OMP model catalog; cannot be changed.
edit.idTaken: This id is already in the list
edit.headersPending: Some header rows are unfinished: complete or remove them before saving
edit.percent: Must be an integer from 1 to 100

manage.title: Manage models: {{name}}
manage.confirmRemove: After removing, these roles become unbound: {{roles}}.
manage.unknownHint: The provider does not say whether these are chat models. For relays and local endpoints they are listed on their own (those without a context window stay off until you fill it in); for provider templates, add them only if they are chat models.

reason.needsAddress: Needs your own address; use a custom provider

openai.name: OpenAI compatible
openai.hint: Relays, local vLLM or Ollama and the like; enter the address

anthropic.name: Anthropic compatible
anthropic.hint: Relays that speak the Anthropic format; enter the address

gemini.name: Gemini compatible
gemini.hint: Relays that speak the Gemini format; enter the address

roles.intro: When a conversation has no model selected and the Profile names none, “Main” is used. A role without a model makes features using it report an error pointing here; no other model is used instead.

status.unknown-model: The bound model {{model}} is unavailable: gone from the catalog or disabled
status.no-credentials: The bound model {{model}} has no key

tiny.name: Tiny
tiny.description: Very small tasks such as titles and tags

fast.name: Fast
fast.description: Approval checks and background tasks that must be quick

compaction.name: Compaction
compaction.description: Writes summaries when compacting long conversations

roles.gradientHelp: Four fixed tiers from light to strong; system features each use one
roles.specialistHelp: Models bound by purpose; you can add your own

effort.unverified: Levels not listed by the model
effort.notOffered: This model has no such level; using {{actual}}

failure.write-conflict: It is being changed elsewhere at the same time; try again later
failure.settings-unavailable: The settings file has errors or cannot be written; fix it first
failure.credentials-unavailable: Could not read or write the credential store
failure.partially-applied: Only half of it was applied; the actual state is shown
failure.model-incomplete: The model needs a context window before it can be enabled
failure.builtin-role: Built-in roles cannot be deleted or renamed
failure.unavailable: The model service is not running
failure.unknown-outcome: It may not have been saved; the settings are authoritative
failure.revision-changed: The model list kept changing; try again shortly
failure.connection-changed: The address or API key changed after detection. Detect again.

header.nameTaken: A provider with this name already exists
header.duplicateTip: Copy the settings and model overrides, including the key
header.keyNotCopied: Duplicated as "{{name}}", but the key was not copied; enter it again.

icon.title: Provider icon
icon.uploadHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP; it is scaled to 128 px. SVG is not accepted

errors.readFailed: The image could not be read
errors.svg: SVG is not accepted; use a bitmap
